about: Vivekanand Cotspin gins raw cotton (kapas) into cotton bales and cotton seed and spins bales into cotton yarn at its facility in Kadi, Mahesana, Gujarat. It also trades cotton bales and yarn. Installed capacity is 8,000 MT of bales and 4,551 MT of yarn; FY26 revenue was about Rs 408 crore.
sector: Textiles - Cotton ginning and yarn spinning

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure on plant and machinery (comber, compact spinning, auto cone winding)
General corporate purposes (capped at 15% of issue or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Promoters and promoter group hold 100% pre-issue. Company converted from an LLP (formed 2015) to a private company in Aug 2024 and to a public company in Dec 2024.

concentration.note: Top 5 customers 34.86% of FY26 revenue (71.95% FY25, 78.88% FY24); top 1 customer 12.02% (29.31% FY25, 38.84% FY24).

litigation_note: Against the company: 4 tax matters, Rs 0.56 crore. Against directors/promoters: 5 tax matters, Rs 0.02 lakh ascertained. Group companies: 14 tax matters and 1 other (Rs 9.17 crore), plus 6 criminal complaints filed by group companies (Rs 1.38 crore). Contingent liabilities Rs 0.54 crore at Mar-26.
strengths: Forward integrated: ginning of raw cotton into bales and seed, and spinning into yarn, under one roof.
Cotton bale capacity utilisation rose from 81.94% in FY24 to 92.82% in FY26.
Customer concentration has eased: top 10 customers fell from 88.73% of revenue in FY24 to 51.18% in FY26.
Revenue grew from Rs 357 crore in FY24 to Rs 408 crore in FY26 with steady EBITDA of about Rs 15 crore.
Debt to equity improved from 3.17 in FY25 to 1.56 in FY26 and net worth rose to Rs 28.94 crore.
Operating cash flow was positive at Rs 8.67 crore in FY26 after a negative FY25.
Experienced promoter family; IPO funds go to machinery for higher-value combed and compact yarn.

risks.title: Thin margins
risks.detail: PAT margin is only 0.90% and EBITDA margin 3.70% in FY26 (peers report EBITDA margins of 3.76% to 11.05%). Small cost shocks can wipe out profit.

risks.title: High leverage and working capital dependence
risks.detail: Borrowings of about Rs 45 crore against net worth of Rs 28.94 crore (D/E 1.56; 3.17 in FY25). Sanctioned working capital Rs 48 crore; current ratio only 1.09.

risks.title: Heavy related party dealings
risks.detail: Sales to related parties were Rs 26.50 crore in FY26 (6.5% of revenue), about 36% in FY25 and 66% in FY24. Purchases and unsecured loans from promoters also exist.

risks.title: Cotton price and seasonality risk
risks.detail: Business depends on raw cotton prices and availability, which vary with weather, trade policy and harvest cycle (peak Nov-Mar). No long-term supplier contracts; top 10 suppliers were 50.61% of FY26 purchases.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 5 customers were 34.86% of FY26 revenue, down from 71.95% in FY25 and 78.88% in FY24, and customers are unnamed. Past concentration shows volatile demand.

risks.title: Negative cash flow history
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 3.72 crore in FY25. FY26 operating cash flow was Rs 8.67 crore but financing flows were negative Rs 7.33 crore.

risks.title: Falling yarn utilisation and dependence on exports via related party
risks.detail: Cotton yarn capacity utilisation fell from 81.38% in FY24 to 67.05% in FY26. Export sales rely on related party Ambica Cotseeds.

risks.title: Corporate record lapses and promoter control
risks.detail: Filing delays and errors with the Registrar of Companies are disclosed. Promoters hold 100% pre-issue and will keep control; 9 tax cases are pending against the company and promoters.

notes: Standalone restated figures (no consolidation). FY25 combines the LLP period (Apr 1 to Aug 4, 2024) and the company period (Aug 5, 2024 to Mar 31, 2025): EPS and ratios as given in the RHP KPI table. Amounts converted from lakhs to Rs crore. Borrowings = long-term plus short-term borrowings, derived from the balance sheet and cross-checked to reported D/E. Price band, issue size, and P/E are blank in the RHP. Business and strengths drawn from the Basis for Issue Price qualitative factors, as the business section was empty. Fresh issue is 60,00,000 shares including up to 3,00,000 for market maker.
